    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    App
     
    Artist
    Artist character card.
    Board
    Game board containing the offer track, decks, and card rows.
    Builder
    Builder character card.
    BuildingCard
    Base class for building cards with persistent effects.
    BuildingCardType
    Identifiers for the different building card effects.
    BuildingDeck
    Deck of building cards, loaded from JSON and arranged by era.
    Card
    Base class for all game cards.
    CardImageRegistry
    Singleton registry that maps card IDs to JavaFX images.
    CardView
    JavaFX component that visually represents a card on the board.
    CardView.State
    Visual state of the card component.
    CavePainting
    Cave Painting event that awards points based on artist count.
    CavePaintingEventBoostBC
    Building that grants bonus food during the Cave Painting event.
    Character
    Base class for character cards.
    CharacterEndPointsBC
    End-game building that grants points per character of a given type.
    CharacterType
    Types of character cards available in the game.
    ClientController
    Client-side controller that connects to the server, sends player actions, and forwards server updates to the UI handler.
    ClientMain
     
    ClientNetworkAdapter
    Client-side adapter that sends player actions to the server.
    ClientSocketHandler
    Handles a single socket client connection on the server side.
    CommunicationProtocol
    Supported communication protocols for client-server connections.
    ConsoleColors
    ANSI color codes used by the TUI.
    DActionStrategy
    Offer action that draws one card from the bottom row.
    DatabaseConnection
    Provides a singleton JDBC connection configured via environment variables.
    DatabaseInitializer
    Ensures the game database and schema exist at server startup.
    DDActionStrategy
    Offer action that draws up to two cards from the bottom row.
    Deck<T>
    Base class for card decks split by era.
    DPick
    Picker that validates a bottom-row card selection.
    DUActionStrategy
    Offer action that draws one card from bottom and one from top if available.
    DUUActionStrategy
    Offer action that draws one bottom-row card and up to two top-row cards.
    EndGameBonus25BC
    End-game building that grants a flat 25-point bonus.
    EndGameBonusBC
    End-game building that doubles points from Builder cards.
    Era
    Game eras used to stage cards and events.
    EventCard
    Base class for event cards resolved during game.
    EventEffect
    Identifiers for event effects resolved during the game.
    FoodActionStrategy
    Offer action that grants a flat food bonus.
    GameDAO
    Data access object for game persistence and ranking queries.
    GameEventListener
    Listener for server-driven events, used to handle network callbacks from the client controller.
    GameOverListener
    Listener notified when a match reaches the game-over phase.
    GamePhase
    Phases of the game lifecycle with transition logic.
    GamePhaseInterface
    Defines how a game phase transitions to the next phase.
    GameState
    Tracks the match flow and exposes transition helpers for rounds, phases, and turn order.
    GameStateUpdateMessage
    DTO carrying a full snapshot of the match state for client views.
    Gatherer
    Gatherer character card.
    GUIApp
    JavaFX application for the GUI client.
    GUIGameController
    Controller for the main game screen.
    GUIHandler
    JavaFX UI handler for GUI VIEW that switches scenes and forwards updates to GUI controllers.
    GUILauncher
    Entry point helper for starting the GUI client.
    GUILobbyController
    Controller for the lobby screen
    GUILoginController
    Controller for the login screen; validates input and starts the client
    GUIRankingController
    Controller for the ranking/results screen.
    Hunter
    Hunter character card.
    HuntEvent
    Hunt event that grants food and points per hunter.
    HuntEventBoostBC
    Building that grants extra food and points during the Hunt event.
    HybridServerNetworkAdapter
    Hybrid server adapter that runs both Socket and RMI servers in parallel and routes outbound notifications to the correct protocol based on the player.
    InvalidCardException
    Thrown when a card does not satisfy the required constraints or type.
    InventionType
    Types of inventions that can appear on cards.
    Inventor
    Inventor character card.
    InventorPairsBC
    Building that rewards new pairs of inventors with the same invention.
    LobbyController
     
    LobbyReadyListener
    Callback invoked by LobbyController when the lobby is full.
    LobbyUpdateMessage
    DTO sent to lobby clients with the current waiting room status.
    MainDeck
    Deck containing character and event cards grouped by era.
    Match
    Represents a single match and acts as the main model entry point for the controller.
    MatchManager
     
    NetworkAdapterFactory
    Factory for client network adapters based on the selected protocol.
    NoDrawableCardException
    Thrown when a draw is requested but no drawable cards are available.
    OfferActionRegistry
    Registry that maps offer effects to their strategies.
    OfferActionStrategy
    Strategy-Pattern interface for resolving offer track actions.
    OfferEffect
    Effects granted by the offer track tiles.
    OfferTile
    Tile on the offer track that may host a player and an effect.
    OfferTileSnapshot
    Serializable snapshot of an offer tile and its occupant.
    OfferTileView
    JavaFX component that represents a tile on the offer track.
    Player
    Represents a player state: resources, owned cards, and character collections.
    PlayerColorRegistry
    Singleton registry that assigns a JavaFX color to each player.
    PlayerPanelView
    Player panel component showing stats and owned cards.
    PlayerSlot
    Slot on the turn order tile that holds a player and its reward/penalty.
    PlayerSnapshot
    Serializable snapshot of a player's public state.
    RankingEntry
    Ranking entry DTO used in ranking updates.
    RankingUpdateMessage
    DTO carrying the global ranking list and the recipient's position.
    RMIClientCallback
    Remote client-side interface exposed to the server for callbacks.
    RMIClientCallbackImpl
    Client-side RMI callback implementation that forwards events to a listener.
    RMIClientConnection
    Adapter that bridges ServerNotifier calls to the client's RMI callback.
    RMIClientNetworkAdapter
    RMI-based client adapter that invokes RMIGameServer methods on the server.
    RMIGameServer
    Remote server-side interface exposed via RMI.
    RMIServerNetworkAdapter
    RMI-based server adapter that exposes RMIGameServer and dispatches actions to the ServerController while using callbacks to notify clients.
    RoundFlowBC
    Building that allows drawing a top-row card after round resolution.
    RoundFlowTotemBC
    Building that grants food when returning to a bonus tile.
    ServerController
    Server-side controller that validates player actions, updates the match state, and broadcasts snapshots to connected clients.
    ServerLogger
    Utility logger for server-side components with colored prefixes.
    ServerMain
     
    ServerNetworkAdapter
    Abstraction for server-side network adapters (RMI, Socket, or hybrid).
    ServerNotifier
    Sends server-to-client notifications for lobby, match, and shutdown events.
    SetCollectionEndPointsBC
    End-game building that scores completed character sets.
    SetCollectionFoodBC
    Building that grants food when completing new character sets.
    Shaman
    Shaman character card.
    ShamanicDoublePointsBC
    Building that doubles shamanic ritual points for the top player.
    ShamanicNoMalusBC
    Building that prevents malus points during the shamanic ritual.
    ShamanicRitual
    Shamanic Ritual event that awards and penalizes points by star counts.
    ShamanicStarsBC
    Building that grants extra shamanic stars.
    SocketClientNetworkAdapter
    Socket-based client adapter that sends JSON commands and processes server events.
    SocketServerNetworkAdapter
    Socket-based server adapter that accepts client connections and forwards incoming actions to the server controller, while pushing events back to clients.
    Sustenance
    Sustenance event that requires players to pay food or points.
    SustenanceDiscountBC
    Building that grants a sustenance discount based on a character type.
    TUIHandler
    Text-based UI handler for TUI VIEW that renders updates and collects player input.
    TUILauncher
    Entry point helper for starting the TUI client.
    TurnOrderTile
    Turn order tile containing slots with their food/points effects.
    TurnSlotSnapshot
    Serializable snapshot of a turn order slot.
    TurnSlotView
    JavaFX component that represents the turn order tile.
    UActionStrategy
    Offer action that draws one card from the top row.
    UIHandler
    UI abstraction for client views (TUI/GUI) to receive updates and prompts.
    UPick
    Picker that validates a top-row card selection.
    UUActionStrategy
    Offer action that draws up to two cards from the top row.
    Visitable
    Contract for model elements that can accept a Visitor.
    Visitor
    Visitor for model elements that support double dispatch.
